theme: Central professional network and legal-portal coordination

builderOriginatedCandidates.problem: Professional account, membership, and portal-participation concepts were distributed across multiple records and could be understood as separate portal relationships.
builderOriginatedCandidates.result: Implemented one Smarter Justice professional identity and professional-scoped network view across qualifying legal portals.

builderOriginatedCandidates.problem: Firms needed one explicit organization model for multiple professionals, offices, seats, billing administration, and future permissions.
builderOriginatedCandidates.result: Implemented firm organizations, actual firm-office references, per-professional seats, billing foundations, and volume-discount readiness.

builderOriginatedCandidates.problem: Firm-wide practice descriptions could be mistaken for individual attorney specialty evidence.
builderOriginatedCandidates.result: Implemented separately governed individual practice assignments and portal assignments with payment-independent approval states.

builderOriginatedCandidates.problem: Dedicated legal portals lacked one versioned professional metadata boundary.
builderOriginatedCandidates.result: Implemented 25 D2 contract-tested read-only handoffs with allowed fields, prohibited data classes, failure states, and no automatic writes.

builderOriginatedCandidates.problem: Live billing, pricing, checkout, inquiry, appointment, and sponsorship activation lacks complete approved production controls.
builderOriginatedCandidates.result: Built safe foundations while keeping every commercial and contact gate closed.

builderOriginatedCandidates.problem: A clean current individual-level source batch was not independently researched during this architecture release.
builderOriginatedCandidates.result: Added zero profiles and preserved exact totals without weak padding.

builderOriginatedCandidates.problem: Smarter Justice must not administer inactive nonlegal pillars.
builderOriginatedCandidates.result: Preserved legal-network-only scope and concise Neutral Boardroom metadata handoff.

ownerBenefit: The owner can manage one professional-business architecture across the legal network, including firms, offices, seats, evidence-gated assignments, entitlement boundaries, and portal contracts.
professionalBenefit: An attorney or firm can eventually maintain one Smarter Justice relationship rather than separate base accounts and subscriptions for every qualifying portal.
publicUserBenefit: Users remain on the relevant specialty portal, while professional placement stays evidence-based and independent from payment.
